content.short: Maya is the Philippines' leading e-wallet, digital bank and merchant payments platform with crypto and credit.
content.description: Maya is the Philippines' leading digital financial platform, combining an e-wallet, a licensed digital bank and a merchant payments network in one ecosystem. Consumers use the app for a wallet, savings and deposit accounts, credit, debit and credit cards, bills payment, QR payments, stock and fund investing, and crypto trading, while businesses use Maya to accept payments online and in store. Regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas through Maya Philippines and Maya Bank, it has grown into one of the country's top digital banks by monthly active users. By serving both consumers and merchants at national scale, Maya sits at the center of the Philippines' shift to cashless payments.
